name: R052-ai-clefable-metronome-mud-sport
why: Challenge 7. The AI's Clefable (389: Metronome, Double Team, Reflect, Follow Me; Leftovers) is the foe of the player's Shuckle 528 (Attack 10, cannot hurt it; Sandstorm / Dig / Flash / Double Team). The script plays Flash (slot 2) 16 turns, then a Snorlax 826 switch ends the battle. Every AI Metronome call is a draw of one of the 336 callable moves (1 in 336). R052: Metronome calls Mud Sport; the AI's next scoring reads the Mud Sport flag. Chance per seed about 0.03.
